body: Iran Air has confirmed that its sole Boeing 747, a 747-200 Combi registered EP-ICD, last flew in mid-September and will remain grounded for months after reaching the cycle threshold for heavy maintenance checks. According to aeroTELEGRAPH, the work will be the first time such heavy maintenance, including a D-Check, has been done in Iran. The work began in late September. Iran Air CEO Taher Abdolhai announced the plans on Telegram following a press conference last week, saying the aircraft had reached the threshold of 20,000 flight cycles and must undergo the necessary repair steps to continue operating; he estimated the work would take 1.5 to two months, although an updated schedule from Iran Air cited by aeroTELEGRAPH puts the timescale closer to six months.

EP-ICD is 38.1 years old, having first flown in September 1988. It entered service with Martinair as PH-MCF, had accumulated some 86,039 flight hours across 17,320 cycles by the time it left Martinair in late 2007, briefly served Turkish carrier Ankair as TC-AKZ in May 2008, and joined Iran Air a month later; it is now configured exclusively for cargo. In recent months it mainly flew between Tehran and Tianjin, China, operating just two round trips to Tianjin in September, the second departing on September 16 and touching back down in Tehran on the morning of September 18, 2026. Abdolhai said: "IranAir is facing fleet limitations, accumulated debts, and a reduction in international routes, while the return of grounded aircraft and the development of flights depend on the supply of parts, financial resources, and compliance with safety requirements."
en.summary: Iran Air has grounded its sole Boeing 747-200 Combi after it reached a heavy maintenance cycle threshold, beginning what is reported to be the first heavy maintenance check including a D-Check ever carried out in Iran.
en.title: Iran Air grounds sole Boeing 747 for first heavy maintenance check in Iran amid sanctions

body: 伊朗航空證實，旗下唯一一架波音747、編號EP-ICD的747-200複合型機，9月中最後一次飛行後停飛，原因是達到重型維修檢查的飛行週期門檻。據aeroTELEGRAPH報導，這將是伊朗首度進行此類重型維修，包含D級檢查。維修工作9月底展開，伊朗航空執行長塔赫爾·阿卜杜勒海在上週記者會後透過Telegram發文公布相關計畫，他表示這架飛機已達到2萬飛行週期的門檻，必須進行必要的維修步驟才能繼續營運，預估需時1.5至2個月；不過aeroTELEGRAPH引述的伊朗航空最新時程則接近6個月。

這架機齡38.1年的飛機1988年9月首飛，最初以PH-MCF編號交付荷蘭馬丁航空，2007年底離開馬丁航空前已累積約86039飛行小時與17320週期，2008年5月短暫服務土耳其安凱航空後一個月加入伊朗航空，現僅作貨運用途。近期該機主要飛航德黑蘭往返中國天津航線，9月僅執行兩趟天津往返班次，9月16日出發的班機於9月18日上午回到德黑蘭，為目前最後一次飛行。執行長坦言，伊朗航空正面臨機隊限制、累積債務與國際航線縮減，停飛飛機的復飛與航班發展取決於零件供應、資金與安全合規。
zh.summary: 伊朗航空唯一一架波音747-200複合型客貨機因達到2萬飛行週期門檻停飛，在德黑蘭接受重型維修，據報這將是伊朗首度進行含D級檢查在內的重型維修。
zh.title: 伊朗航空唯一波音747達2萬飛行週期停飛，首度在伊朗進行D級大修
